title: A merge of a stacked base keeps the review record live
why: Lane ruling-challenge-passes (#3143, stacked on ruling-challenge-passes-5; coordinator 10:43 CST Nov 13): merge --lane-lint demands that the base branch's current head be merged in (step lane-lint-stack-holds-base), but live_review_state keeps a record only across clean merges of main. A merge of the stacked base makes the record stale, so a stacked PR cannot satisfy both checks. #2999 failed the same way.
note: Interim: wait for the base to merge, then retarget to main. Fix: live_review_state treats a clean merge of the PR's own base branch head like a clean merge of main. Done when: a test stacks a reviewed PR, merges the base head into it cleanly, and the record still reads live; a merge with a conflict hunk still reads stale.
